cohort: 215,217 children born between 1995 and 2014 in Skåne, Sweden
finding: Maternal preobesity/obesity, small for gestational age, malformations, induction, elective and emergency cesarean section, Apgar <7 at 5 minutes, and admission to neonatal care were significantly associated with cerebral palsy among term children.
mod_finding: Elective and emergency cesarean section were significantly associated with cerebral palsy in both term and moderately or late preterm infants.
gest_age: Term (≥37 weeks), moderately or late preterm (32-36 weeks), very preterm (<32 weeks)
